meeting.description: Meeting metadata (including extracted decisions) when type is meeting; null otherwise. Always present.

body_markdown.description: The note's distilled markdown body, or null when include_body is false.

action_items.description: Extracted action items (empty for non-meetings or when include_action_items is false).

NoteId.description: Stable note identifier, e.g. "n_a1b2c3". Generated at creation, never rewritten on move/re-route. This is the write handle.

ProjectSlug.description: Hierarchical project path/slug relative to the KB root, e.g. "Growth/Q3". Segments are folder names; no leading/trailing or empty segments. Each segment must also be a legal Windows folder name (no reserved device names such as CON/PRN/NUL, no trailing dot or space, none of the characters Windows forbids in a path segment), and may not start with "." or "_" — those prefixes mark infra folders (".obsidian", "_assets") that routing discovery skips, so such a project would be writable yet invisible to routing. The Phase 2 writer rejects violations. "Inbox" (any casing) is a reserved folder name — a real project may not use it — and "sessions" and "raw" (any casing) are reserved as first segments: <KB root>/sessions/ holds raw session artifacts, never notes ("raw" stays reserved alongside it; a nested segment like "Data/raw" is fine). This is the canonical project handle accepted by tools. Because no real project can be named "Inbox", read tools that filter by project reuse it as a sentinel meaning "unfiled" — see search_notes's project field.

IsoDate.description: Calendar date, ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 full-date, e.g. "2026-07-11".

IsoDateTime.description: Timestamp, RFC 3339 date-time with offset ("Z" or numeric), e.g. "2026-07-11T14:03:00Z" or "2026-07-09T14:00:00-07:00".

ActionItemStatus.description: Action-item status. 'overdue' is derived server-side from 'open' + a past due date.

path.description: Current note path relative to the KB root, e.g. "Growth/Q3/weekly-sync.md". Informational; changes on move.

NoteRef.description: Minimal stable reference to a note: stable id plus current path.

path.description: Current note path relative to the KB root, e.g. "Growth/Q3/weekly-sync.md"; an unfiled (Inbox) note's path begins with "Inbox/". The filename is a slug of the title (or the id when the title slugifies to empty).

title.description: Note display title. The frontmatter `title` when the note carries one (kept in full, past the 40-char filename slug); otherwise the de-slugged filename stem for a legacy or hand-made note without the key.

project.description: Owning project slug, or null if unfiled (Inbox). Frontmatter stores the sentinel string "Inbox" for the null case.

date.description: Frontmatter date, verbatim as stored: full timestamp with the device's local offset (not UTC) when a time is known, local calendar date otherwise. The writer accepts only these two shapes and rejects a naive timestamp with no offset.

tags.description: Frontmatter tags; empty array when the frontmatter key is absent (the writer omits the key for untagged notes, and normalizes a hand-edited empty list to an omitted key). Each tag is lowercase kebab-case.

source.description: Frontmatter source: a capture keyword (transcript | quick-capture | chat | import | manual) or a repo-relative path to the raw artifact. Disambiguation: a value exactly equal to a keyword is that keyword; anything else is the path.

confidence.description: Routing confidence 0..1, or null when no routing score exists (hand-filed or imported notes).

NoteSummary.description: Core note metadata shared by search hits, recent-notes lists, and routing results. Deliberately open (no unevaluatedProperties) because SearchHit and MeetingMeta extend it — see Conventions.

duration_seconds.description: Meeting duration in seconds, or null if unknown.

speaker_count.description: Distinct speaker count (channel-based; names not resolved in v1), or null.

action_item_count.description: Number of action items extracted from this meeting.

MeetingMeta.description: Meeting-specific metadata: a NoteSummary plus meeting fields.

owner.description: Who owns it (e.g. "you" or a person's name).

due_date.description: Due date, or null if none.

source.description: The meeting note this item was extracted from.

extracted_date.description: Date the item was extracted (usually the meeting date).

ActionItem.description: An extracted action / outstanding item linked to its source note.
